# first_window_probes.txt - DEMO-1 D6-red (D-W8-72): the 12 static probes of the example first_window, read on
# both systems (the Linux capture in the protocol and the two Windows captures). Format: tests/tools/image_probe.py
# ("<x> <y> <RRGGBBAA> [<tol>]", origin top-left, alpha included). Fixed BEFORE the data existed (GODS_LAWS.md
# L-43): every value comes from the sRGB formula, never from a capture. No probe in the band y 400 to 431, where
# the green square moves. The scene is in the header comment of examples/first_window/first_window.cpp.
#
# the four corners: the background, 0.2 encoded by the CPU = 124 = 0x7C
0 0 7C7C7CFF 1
639 0 7C7C7CFF 1
0 479 7C7C7CFF 1
639 479 7C7C7CFF 1
# A, red, outside the overlap with B
80 80 FF0000FF 0
# B, blue, outside the overlap with A
250 150 0000FFFF 0
# the overlap of A and B: B is on layer 1, so blue
200 150 0000FFFF 0
# C, half-transparent white, over the background: 0.5 * 255 + 0.5 * 124 = 189.5
450 300 BDBDBDFF 2
# C over B: 0.5 * 255 on red and green, blue stays 255
330 230 8080FFFF 2
# the first column INSIDE the left edge of C (x = 300), over the background and over B: no fringe
300 300 BDBDBDFF 2
300 230 8080FFFF 2
# a background point between the pieces
560 100 7C7C7CFF 1
